comment: Metric-view base for KYC health (mv_kyc_health, D13): a record_type union of Review Snapshot rows (one per KYC review x month-end in which it fell due, was completed or was overdue; Apr-2023 to Sep-2026) and Screening rows (one per sanctions / PEP / adverse-media alert, Apr-2024 to Sep-2026). Both carry the month-end, booking country, segment, the client's KYC risk rating and a status (review status at the month-end, or the screening disposition). Review flags live only on Review Snapshot rows and screening fields only on Screening rows. Overdue at month-end is point-in-time (take the latest month-end, never sum months); due, completed and screening alerts are flows. Examples: Overdue = COUNT_IF(is_overdue_at_month_end); High-Risk Overdue = COUNT_IF(is_overdue_at_month_end AND is_high_risk); Screening True Match Rate % = COUNT_IF(is_true_match) / COUNT_IF(is_screening_alert). Grain: one row per record_type x record (review x month-end, or screening alert).
